name: Mulcahy's
reviewNotes:
Added for its own event calendar in src/content/sources (PR #8). The dance floor has not been researched yet.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Wantagh is in Nassau County (Town of Hempstead). The site warns that hours on Google are often wrong; the venue opens for events only, so hours are given as event-based. Bing/Yelp hours (Mon-Thu 9-5, Fri-Sat 9-11:30 PM) were not used. Short domain muls.com is used in their posts; mulcahyslongisland.com is the site itself. No modern exterior photo on the venue site (only a sketch and a 1960s archive photo), so photos are of the ballroom. Capacity about 1,200 per a ticket site (not recorded).
hours: Open for scheduled shows and parties; door times vary by event (see each listing). Office Mon-Sat 10 AM-6 PM
description: A big concert hall and pub next to the Wantagh train station, with a main ballroom stage, several bars and private party rooms. It hosts touring and tribute bands, country nights and DJ dance parties such as 80s and 90s nights.

logo.alt: Mulcahy's logo: the name in green script on a banner over an electric guitar, with the words Good Clean Fun

evidence.note: Venue site footer gives 3232 Railroad Ave, Wantagh, NY 11793 and 516.783.7500; says there is no set closing time and door times depend on each show; office is open Mon-Sat 10 AM-6 PM.
Contact page links the Facebook, Instagram and YouTube pages and lists info@mulcahys.com and the 516 phone.
Venue tour page describes the 2019 expansion from a small railroad tavern into a full event center with a ballroom stage and several rooms.
Home page event list shows tribute bands, an 80s vs 90s DJ night, a 2000s hip hop and R&B party and country shows.
